notes:
Cayor (Kajoor), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Cayor (the title "Kingdom of Cayor" did not load).

The end is inconsistent on the page: the lead gives 1876, the body 1886 (followed). The page has no area, no treaty of 1864 and no Dékilé; Lat Jor's reigns are 1862-1863 and "until 1872" there. The shape is the Thiès region and Cap-Vert, the same land as in the jolof-empire dossier; the page's Cayor was probably larger along the Ndiambour coast (not drawn). The Damel-Teigne union with Baol (1549-1756) is an administrative union: Baol is drawn as part of the realm. Baol (Diourbel) needs its own dossier from 1549 and 1756.
Gazetteer: Mboul, Tivaouane (place), Ndiambour (region).
